name: Discipline & Execution
description: Daily habit consistency, resistance to procrastination, follow-through under stress, and anti-avoidance.

dimensions.name: Resistance to Avoidance
dimensions.description: Tackling the most uncomfortable or humiliating weakness drill first without rationalizing delays.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Attacks highest-friction weakness immediately; zero excuses.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Completes drill with minor hesitation or procrastination.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Postpones corrective drill to end of day or asks for easier alternatives.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Blatant avoidance; fabricates excuses to skip difficult challenges.

dimensions.name: Daily Operating Rhythm
dimensions.description: Maintaining non-negotiable daily training baseline regardless of mood, fatigue, or schedule.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Never misses a day; completes planned minutes with maximum intensity.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Consistent daily practice with occasional reduced duration.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Erratic attendance (trains hard 2 days, goes missing for 3 days).
rubricCriteria.0-49: Total lack of discipline; abandons system after initial novelty wears off.
